standard-dialogue.npc: Oh great, another customer. What do you want?

options.text: I'd like to access my bank account, please.
I'd like to check my PIN settings.
What are you doing out here?

steps.player: What are you doing out here?

steps.npc: I used to work in the East Varrock branch. Then a request came in to set up a bank in this new town.
The other clerks and myself pulled straws and I was unlucky enough to be sent to this stinking death trap.
Now I'm stuck here, ferrying items back and forth to the bank's safe in Varrock for people like you.

steps.player: That doesn't sound very fun, but you're doing a great service for us adventurers.

steps.npc: Tell that to my back and legs, I'm exhausted from carrying all this junk back and forth.

using-un-noted-items-on-the-banker.npc: Hand me a banknote, and I'll try to convert it to an item.

using-coins-on-the-banker.prompt: Exchange your coins for platinum tokens?

using-platinum-tokens-on-the-banker.prompt: Exchange your platinum tokens for coins?
